correctness.rationale: The mean-zero constraint solves for the common junction value; Dirichlet loop kernels min(s,t)-st/L and anchored pendant kernels min(s,t) yield Q_loop=B+(T-L)s(L-s)/(TL) and Q_pend=B+[s²+(T-2h)s]/T with B=(sum L³/12+sum h³/3)/T². Loop strict concavity and pendant-tip comparison give K=B+max{M(T-M)/4,H(T-H)}/T and Riesz extremizers, for every positive length and all ties. One-pendant crossover h_c=M(A-M)/(4A-M), and maximizing t(1-t)/(4-t) on (0,1) gives 7-4sqrt(3), including the two-loop attainment and r=1 boundary. Independently computed exact rational equal diagonals 107/630 at loops (1,1), h=1/7; inspected finite rational resistance checker, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Finite rational examples do not prove all positive real length configurations; the proof supplies all-real optimization.
